item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jeffries defends himself following criticism for meeting with Jared Kushner
item.description: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries is defending his private meeting with Jared Kushner after backlash from the left. He also says impeaching Trump isn't off the table.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Canadian children's media company WildBrain purchases generative AI startup
item.description: The Canadian children's media company who owns the rights to shows like “Yo Gabba Gabba!” and "Johnny Test" has purchased Personality AI, a child-focused generative AI startup.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 15-year-old arrested after teen stabbed near Lennard High School: HCSO
item.description: A 15-year-old was arrested on an attempted murder charge after another teenager was stabbed Monday afternoon near a 7-Eleven in Ruskin, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

item.description: Look Alive Coffee received $1,500 back from one importer, but co-owner Michael Packard says coffee market volatility — driven by El Niño — remains his biggest concern.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FBI sets $25,000 minimum reward for dozens of unsolved Indian Country cases
item.description: The FBI has established a minimum reward of $25,000 for help in solving some cold cases where people went missing or were killed in Indian Country.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] What's next after Supreme Court clears path for Trump mail-in ballot order ahead of midterms?
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that states lacked standing to block President Trump's mail-in ballot executive order, but left its overall legality unresolved ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Deportation crackdown accelerates with highest ICE arrest total in months
item.description: ICE made nearly 50,000 arrests in July, the highest monthly total of Trump’s second term, as mass deportation efforts intensified nationwide.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Australia's music industry bans AI-generated tracks from official charts
item.description: Australia's recorded music industry will bar tracks wholly generated by artificial intelligence from official charts as burgeoning generative technologies threaten artists' livelihoods, a representative said on Tuesday.
